column1: Check for Duplicate Orders (Primary Key Integrity)

column2: SELECT      order_id,      COUNT(*) AS frequency FROM orders GROUP BY order_id HAVING frequency > 1 LIMIT 0, 1000
SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS freq FROM customers GROUP BY customer_id HAVING freq > 1 LIMIT 0, 1000
SELECT product_id, COUNT(*) AS freq FROM products GROUP BY product_id HAVING freq > 1 LIMIT 0, 1000
SELECT order_id, payment_sequential, COUNT(*) AS freq  FROM payments  GROUP BY order_id, payment_sequential  HAVING freq > 1 LIMIT 0, 1000
SELECT seller_id, COUNT(*) AS duplicate_count FROM olist_ecommerce_sellers GROUP BY seller_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 LIMIT 0, 1000
SELECT COUNT(i.order_id) AS orphaned_items FROM order_items i LEFT JOIN orders o      ON i.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_id IS NULL LIMIT 0, 1000
SELECT COUNT(p.order_id) AS orphaned_payments FROM payments p LEFT JOIN orders o ON p.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_id IS NULL LIMIT 0, 1000
SELECT COUNT(o.customer_id) AS orphaned_orders FROM orders o LEFT JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.customer_id IS NULL LIMIT 0, 1000
SELECT COUNT(i.product_id) AS orphaned_products FROM order_items i LEFT JOIN products p ON i.product_id = p.product_id WHERE p.product_id IS NULL LIMIT 0, 1000
SELECT COUNT(r.order_id) AS orphaned_reviews FROM olist_ecommerce_order_reviews r LEFT JOIN orders o ON r.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_id IS NULL LIMIT 0, 1000

column1: Check for Financial Anomalies (Zero or Negative Prices)

column2: SELECT      order_id,      price FROM order_items WHERE CAST(price AS DECIMAL(10,2)) <= 0 LIMIT 0, 1000
SELECT order_id, payment_value  FROM payments  WHERE CAST(payment_value AS DECIMAL(10,2)) <= 0 LIMIT 0, 1000
SELECT product_id, product_weight_g  FROM products  WHERE CAST(product_weight_g AS DECIMAL(10,2)) <= 0 LIMIT 0, 1000
